description: MAIN-PARA's EIBCALEN = 0 guard at app/cbl/COMEN01C.cbl:82-84 - transaction CM00 typed at a clear screen with no communication area at all. Line 83 moves 'COSGN00C' into CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM - FROM, not TO, and the asymmetry with line 97 is in the source and is reproduced - and performs RETURN-TO-SIGNON-SCREEN, whose abbreviated combined relation at line 172 then finds CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM naming nothing and defaults it to 'COSGN00C' as well. No map is sent, so "sends" is empty and the response IS the whole observable behaviour, which is why it is stated field by field across all sixteen COCOM01Y fields; the single line the run emits is the 78-byte ERRMSGO that line 80 blanked, declared on the SCREEN_ERRMSG_78 channel because the 80-byte WS-MESSAGE of line 38 is working storage and only a controller produces the screen field app/cpy-bms/COMEN01.CPY:260 declares PIC X(78) - the service cases pin the eighty instead. nextMapset and nextMap are omitted rather than named: an XCTL hands control on, and neither line 153 nor line 176 names a map, so naming COMEN01 and COMEN1A here would tell the client to paint the screen this program is leaving. The XCTL at 175-177 specifies NO COMMAREA, unlike the option transfer at 152-155. EIBAID is never read on this path because line 93 is not reached, so no AID is declared: naming one would imply the key mattered. Driven through the controller because an absent request body is how GET /api/menu expresses EIBCALEN = 0, and the invocation is declared in screenRequest because that is where ParityCase requires an online request to live: jobParameters models a JCL PARM and is refused for any unit kind other than BATCH_JOB. The transfer travels as a nextProgram response field with the area in the payload rather than as a server-side forward, which is gates G37 and G40. This is the earliest of MAIN-PARA's three arms and it is neither the ENTER nor the REENTER path, so gate G38's pair is honoured by its neighbours: the ENTER half is case02 at lines 87-90 and the REENTER half is the EVALUATE EIBAID at 93-103, which case04 through case15 drive arm by arm. Nothing is highlighted here and nothing may be: G38 is usually phrased around the DFHRED-and-asterisk highlight CSSETATY applies, but COMEN01C does not copy CSSETATY - its COPY list at lines 50-61 is COCOM01Y, COMEN02Y, COMEN01, COTTL01Y, CSDAT01Y, CSMSG01Y, CSUSR01Y, DFHAID and DFHBMSCA - and DFHRED appears nowhere in its 282 lines. Red reaches the screen only as ERRMSG's declared COLOR at app/bms/COMEN01.bms:154-157, and the one attribute byte the program ever writes is the DFHGREEN of line 158, on the coming-soon path this case never reaches; expecting a highlight, an asterisk or a thank-you line would be inventing behaviour, and COTTL01Y's CCDA-THANK-YOU and CSMSG01Y's CCDA-MSG-THANK-YOU are both copied in and neither is ever referenced. inputs, expectedWrites and expectedFinalState are all empty because COMEN01C performs no dataset access whatsoever: the migration's dataset usage map groups the program under USRSEC, yet it only declares WS-USRSEC-FILE at line 39 and copies CSUSR01Y at line 58 - there is no SELECT, no FD and no file operand anywhere in it - and case18 pins that absence for the whole directory. Line 150's MOVE SEC-USR-TYPE TO CDEMO-USER-TYPE is commented out, so user type is inbound only, and on this path none arrives at all. The clock is pinned to 2022-07-19T23:12:33, the timestamp COMEN01C's own version footer at line 281 carries, so the instant is anchored in the source rather than chosen, and all twenty cases in this directory pin that same instant and name US-ASCII explicitly rather than leaving a code page to a platform default. POPULATE-HEADER-INFO does not run here, so no header is painted and the instant changes nothing this case asserts; it is declared all the same, so that one clock governs the directory and no two cases can differ by their clock. Every expected value above is statically derived - read out of the COBOL paragraph that produces it and cross-checked against the 160-byte layout of app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy, the xxxI PICTURE clauses of app/cpy-bms/COMEN01.CPY and the DFHMDF definitions of app/bms/COMEN01.bms - and none of it was captured from an execution of the legacy program, which is empirically impossible here: no z/OS or CICS runtime, an indexed file handler the available compiler reports as disabled, no Language Environment CEE services, and DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR absent from the repository. The substitution is escalated rather than absorbed (risk R-A). The navigation map is pinned EMPTY, and that is the whole point of stating this case through the controller: the XCTL at app/cbl/COMEN01C.cbl:175-177 names NO COMMAREA option, so nothing is handed to COSGN00C and its own EIBCALEN = 0 guard at app/cbl/COSGN00C.cbl:80-83 is what answers - the cold start that clears every output field, puts the cursor on the user id, validates nothing and reads no USRSEC record. The program's own CARDDEMO-COMMAREA does still hold all sixteen values at that instant, which is why the SERVICE cases for this same path pin all sixteen; what the transfer PASSES is the separate fact, and a response echoing an area here would make the client send one on and drive sign-on down its re-entry path instead. FieldDiffer.compareNavigation compares in both directions, so an empty expectation is enforced: a single commarea field appearing in the response is a diff.
